Do you want anything? | I'm gonna grab ___ — want anything? | 办公室午后，随口问同事要不要带咖啡

1 | I'm just looking, thanks. | 我先随便看看，谢谢。 | life | 店员一靠近就用这句，礼貌拒绝不尴尬 | /aɪm dʒʌst ˈlʊkɪŋ θæŋks/ | just 弱读 /dʒəs/; looking 的 ing 读 /ɪŋ/，不要读成 /ɪn/ | Just browsing, thanks.; I'm good, thanks. | I only see see. | I'm just ___, thanks. | 进店后店员问 Can I help you?

3 | I'll do the burger, medium. | 我要汉堡，五分熟。 | dining | I'll do = 我要，比 I'll have 更随意干练 | /aɪl du ðə ˈbɜrɡər ˈmidiəm/ | I'll do 连读 /aɪldu/; medium 三个音节别吞音 /ˈmidiəm/ | I'll go with the burger, medium. | I want hamburger five mature. | I'll do the ___, ___. | 服务员记单，问你汉堡要几分熟

3 | I'm starving — let's order a bunch. | 我饿坏了，多点几个。 | dining | starving 比 hungry 情绪强，日常口语首选 | /aɪm ˈstɑrvɪŋ lɛts ˈɔrdər ə bʌntʃ/ | starving 的 ar 卷舌 /ˈstɑrvɪŋ/; let's 读 /lɛts/ 一个音节 | I'm starving — let's go big. | I am very hunger, let us order more. | I'm starving — let's ___. | 和朋友进店，饿到不行

4 | I'll pass on the sauce. | 酱我就不要了。 | dining | pass on = 不要了，比 no 更委婉有分寸 | /aɪl pæs ɑn ðə sɔs/ | pass on 连读 /pæsɑn/; sauce 的 au 读 /ɔ/ | I'll skip the sauce.; No sauce for me, thanks. | I don't want sauce. | I'll pass on the ___. | 服务员问要不要加特制酱

5 | What do you recommend? | 你推荐什么？ | dining | 万能问推荐句，餐厅、理发、买车都能用 | /wʌt du ju ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd/ | do you 弱读 /dju/; recommend 重音在最后 /ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd/ | What would you recommend?; Any recommendations? | What do you suggest me to eat? | What do you recommend for ___? | 菜单太多看不懂，直接问服务员
